# 8093 - Tri-state quad buffer

Package DIP-14 · family DM80 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/8093.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/8093.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 46 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![8093 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/8093.png) | ![8093 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-8093.png) | ![8093 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-8093.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 14 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 1 | C1 | enable | low |  | controls pins 3; when not enabled: float; control: high puts the output in high impedance |
| 2 | A1 | input |  |  |  |
| 3 | Y1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 1 |
| 4 | C2 | enable | low |  | controls pins 6; when not enabled: float; control: high puts the output in high impedance |
| 5 | A2 | input |  |  |  |
| 6 | Y2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 4 |
| 10 | C3 | enable | low |  | controls pins 8; when not enabled: float; control: high puts the output in high impedance |
| 9 | A3 | input |  |  |  |
| 8 | Y3 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 10 |
| 13 | C4 | enable | low |  | controls pins 11; when not enabled: float; control: high puts the output in high impedance |
| 12 | A4 | input |  |  |  |
| 11 | Y4 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 13 |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3,6,8,11 | Y = A when C = L; Z when C = H | Non-inverting buffer; a high on its control input puts the output in the high-impedance state. Pin-equivalent to the 74125. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -5.2 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | IOH -5.2 mA and IOL 16 mA are from the electrical table. Off-state current -40/+40 uA. Up to 128 devices on one bus line. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | Y | PLH | 10 | 15 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| A | Y | PHL | 12 | 18 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| C | Y | PZH | 12 | 18 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| C | Y | PZL | 16 | 25 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 50 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| C | Y | PHZ | 5 | 8 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 5 pF, RL 400 ohm |
| C | Y | PLZ | 9 | 14 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 5 pF, RL 400 ohm |
